description: At the foot of Niebla's walls at night, the medieval ramparts and gate rise dark and imposing above the road. The red-brick fortifications stretch along the hill, their crenellations black against the starlit sky. The gate stands closed and silent, the little walled town asleep behind its ancient defenses.
